title: Joey's inbox
brief:
KODEX: Joey's mail is open. Anything from the people who'd know about the building?

Show the subject and body of every mail whose sender is 'Facilities' or 'Linda Park'.
successMessage: Facilities moved to HR as 'People & Facilities'. And Joey has a... reputation.

cells: Facilities is now People & Facilities, run from HR on Floor 2. Power, lifts and the cleaning rota: all requests go to them.
Joey. Four bathroom breaks in one meeting. Ken timed them. Ken has a spreadsheet.
Office C's spare key is in your drawer. Stop 'borrowing' Omar's stapler.
